entry.title: City of Roseburg and ODOT to plan improvements for OR 138E and Diamond Lake Boulevard
entry.summary: A plan to make roadways safer and more accommodating for motorists, cyclists and pedestrians on Diamond Lake Boulevard and Oregon Route 138 East is in the works between the City of Roseburg and Oregon Department of Transportation (ODOT).
